scripts.//check:reachability: Reachability gate: a production module outside the Renderer, Electron main build graphs is dead code. The graph follows static, dynamic and import.meta.glob edges and has no allowlist.
scripts.//check:bundle: First-load gate: dist/index.html may only modulepreload the app-shell vendors and the entry's static JS+CSS must stay under a gzip budget. Guards the 2026-09-05 first-load rework (a static chain or an over-capturing manualChunks rule re-statics a heavy vendor without failing any test).
scripts.//check:i18n: Locale integrity gate: zh-CN/de-DE must mirror the en-US key tree exactly, and every literal t() key in src/ must resolve in en-US. Guards the shipped-missing permissions decision labels (dynamic keys escaped every other check).
scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:electron && pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run check:reachability && pnpm run build:main && vite build && pnpm run check:bundle && pnpm run check:contrast
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native:cli && pnpm run fetch:search-tools && pnpm run build:unimod && pnpm run build:psimod && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.json
scripts.desktop:dist:prep: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native:cli && pnpm run fetch:search-tools && pnpm run build:unimod && pnpm run build:psimod
scripts.agent:harness: pnpm run build:native:cli && pnpm run build:main && node electron/dist/agent-harness.cjs
scripts.//test:e2e: Playwright drives two surfaces: the renderer in Chromium (tests/e2e) and the REAL Electron app against the real Backend (tests/desktop). build:main runs first because the desktop project launches electron/dist/main.bundle.cjs -- a stale bundle would test the previous commit, and a MISSING electron/dist/preload.cjs is exactly the defect this suite was written to catch.
